summary: Cumberland County, TN: the tower is labelled on a 1936 topographic map and Tennessee Landforms lists it standing; no builder, build date or staffing found.

visit.trail_note: Tennessee Landforms advises against climbing these towers because steps are often removed or rotten; we found no public visiting arrangement

events.note: Earliest date found, not the build date. The tower is labelled the Lantana Lookout Tower on a 1936 topographic map of Crossville.

notes_for_editor: Earliest evidence is the 1936 map, so the build date and builder are unknown. Standing status rests on one undated Tennessee Landforms list plus the OpenStreetMap entry; not verified on site. The cached NHLR Tennessee list (which says 76 lookouts are registered) does not include Lantana, Jakes Mountain or Jennings Knob. A Chamber of Commerce listing gives a Lantana Firetower Road address in Crossville, but it is a business directory, so it is not cited. Access level is left out because no source states one. Two WebSearch calls were used.
